subnet_discovery.name: Subnet Host Discovery (Ping Sweep)
subnet_discovery.command: nmap -v -sn {target_subnet} -oG scans/host_discovery.gnmap && grep Up scans/host_discovery.gnmap | cut -d ' ' -f 2 > scans/live_hosts.txt
subnet_discovery.description: Fast ICMP/ARP host discovery across a CIDR block.

subnet_discovery.name: Subnet Host Discovery (SYN Sweep)
subnet_discovery.command: sudo nmap -sS -v {target_subnet} -oG scans/syn_discovery.gnmap && grep open scans/syn_discovery.gnmap | cut -d ' ' -f 2 > scans/live_hosts.txt
subnet_discovery.description: SYN sweep to discover hosts blocking ICMP pings.
